criteria.justification: The diff modifies V3__create_preference_profiles.sql, an already-applied migration, by adding a new column — corrections to an applied migration must go in a new V{n+1} file instead. Separately, the new V6__create_profile_audit.sql uses SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, which is Postgres-specific and not the portable BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY idiom this repo uses, risking a parse failure on H2.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is changed from validate to update in application.properties, directly reversing the pinned fail-fast validation convention that this file itself used to document via comment, and letting Hibernate silently mutate the schema instead of failing at boot on a mapping mismatch.

PreferenceProfileService, a @Service under src/main/java, gains a field-level @Autowired ProfileAuditRepository dependency alongside its existing private final constructor-injected fields, reintroducing exactly the field-injection pattern AGENTS.md forbids in favor of @RequiredArgsConstructor.

A new GET /profile/{userId} endpoint takes a client-supplied userId path variable and loads the profile with it directly (loadFormForUser(userId), hasProfile(userId)) without ever resolving the id via CurrentUserService.requireUserId(principal). This is a textbook IDOR: any authenticated user can view another user's profile by changing the path id.

A fixed page.waitForTimeout(500) is added to HtmxSmokeE2eTests.java after clicking the toggle, in place of an assertion-based or condition-based wait. The suite's stated convention (and the rest of the file, unchanged here) contains no sleeps; this reintroduces the flakiness pattern the convention exists to avoid, though the subsequent PlaywrightAssertions.assertThat calls still remain intact.

The only test-source change is the added waitForTimeout line in an existing e2e test; the surrounding assertThat(toggle) assertions are untouched and still verify the toggle's attribute and text, so no verification is weakened, removed, or made tautological in this diff.

findings.message: V3__create_preference_profiles.sql is an already-applied migration (no 'new file mode' in its diff header); adding the display_nickname column here edits it in place instead of introducing the column via a new V{n+1} migration. Neon's free tier has no rollback, so this is irreversible in production.

id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY is Postgres-specific DDL, not the portable BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY idiom used elsewhere in this repo; this risks failing to parse on H2 in PostgreSQL-compatibility mode, opening a dual-engine portability hole the migration set did not previously have.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is switched from validate to update, defeating the fail-fast schema-mapping check that was previously enforced in every profile and letting Hibernate silently alter the schema.

profileAuditRepository is injected via field @Autowired on a @Service class instead of being added to the constructor-injected private final fields (@RequiredArgsConstructor), reintroducing field injection where the codebase has none.

New GET /profile/{userId} handler loads and renders another user's preference profile using a client-supplied userId path variable, never resolving ownership via CurrentUserService.requireUserId(principal). Any authenticated user can view any other user's profile by changing the id — an IDOR hole on a route family that previously carried no id at all.

page.waitForTimeout(500) is a fixed sleep added after the toggle click; the convention requires assertion-based or condition-based waits (PlaywrightAssertions.assertThat auto-waits, or page.waitForFunction) and the suite otherwise contains no sleeps.
